requirements_summary: Migrate from in-house FAISS + lexical stack to a two-stage pipeline: dense embedding retrieval (100M-10B vectors) + learned reranker. Must retain or improve current relevance (NDCG and MRR) — strict no-regression. Latency budget: first-pass retrieval p50 ~ 60ms, rerank end-to-end p95 < 450ms. Cost target: <$0.005/query at 1M QPS/month equivalent. Need SSO (SAML), KMS, audit logs, EU residency for HR/legal docs, and ability to run A/B and canary rollouts controlled by traffic routing policies.
